messages:
maria: Heads up — HelixCorp CPO (Linda) just raised an exec escalation. She wants a concise list of blockers + a timeline by EOD Tue. Key asks: SSO test account, completed security questionnaire, dedicated capacity pricing, and BYO KMS integration details. I can handle the pricing note but need help on SSO and the security Q.

kevin: copying the thread. timeline is tight — they want a decision for pilot later this month. can we turn around the sec questionnaire in 24–48h? :eyes:

anya: I can draft answers for the questionnaire today. which version did they send? link?

maria: the doc link is in the deal binder: https://redwood.internal/deals/helixcorp/sec-questionnaire-v3.docx. it's the one with SOC2 + KMS sections.

kevin: noted. i'll ping procurement on a SSO test account — they asked for an Okta test instance that mirrors their prod SCIM groups.

sachin: I'll take the KMS/BYO section. quick Q: do they want HSM attestation or just KMS key wrap? Linda mentioned FIPS/HSM but not specific attestation.

maria: Linda said "attestation preferred" but will accept KMS + proof of key control if needed. we should prepare both options.

dave: On Dedicated capacity pricing: we can offer a 3-month pilot at reserved baseline with a monthly overage. i'll draft the numbers — need their expected RPS and seq length distribution. kevin, can you confirm expected qps for the pilot?

kevin: Pilot target: 50 concurrent sessions, avg prompt 400 tokens, peak 300 reqs/min. i'll confirm with them tonight.

anya: For the security questionnaire I'll start populating the sections I own (network, logging, data retention). Sachin, can you add KMS answers inline? i'll flag any product limitations.

sachin: yes. I'll attach the KMS diagram and a short note about HSM options and the attestation path. also will include our recommended fallback (key proxy model) if customer cannot use BYO KMS in pilot.

maria: appreciate it. ops-bot will run a quick checklist for SSO test account requests. ops-bot, please create a ticket and route to infra oncall.

ops-bot: Created ticket RW-8742: SSO Test Instance for HelixCorp. Assigned to infra-oncall. ETA 24h.

dave: Quick engineering note: the current runtime supports SCIM group sync but we need a short config template for group mapping. putting template here:
```
scim:
  group_mapping:
    product_team: redwood_group_123
    analytics: redwood_group_456
```
Use that for the Okta test tenant.

anya: thanks, dave. i'll paste that into the questionnaire answer and the playbook for the customer.

kevin: i'm prepping a one-pager for the CPO that lists: 1) blockers + owners, 2) proposed timeline, 3) pricing summary. Maria — any strong preferences on the timeline?

maria: propose this:
- Mon: SSO test instance live + initial security Q draft
- Tue AM: KMS attestation note + pricing final
- Tue EOD: Deliver consolidated packet to CPO + VP Eng
If any item slips, we escalate to exec on Wed morning.

kevin: sounds good. i'll ask Helix to confirm the pilot RPS numbers tonight and try to get the Okta admin contact.

sachin: One blocker to flag: if they require full HSM attestation (FIPS 140-2 level 3), lead time for vendor paperwork is 3–4 weeks. we should state that clearly in the packet and offer the interim key wrap option.

maria: Good call. include that sentence verbatim.

anya: I'll drop the draft questionnaire into this thread when it's ready. expect a first pass ~6pm PT.

kevin: I'll update the exec one-pager and send to Maria for sign-off before we hand it to the customer.

dave: FYI — if we need to spin Dedicated GPUs for the pilot, we can carve a pool but need 48h lead to provision on the Dedicated fleet.

maria: Noted. i'll mark provisioning as dependent on confirmed pilot RPS.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up ping in 12h for RW-8742.

maria: Action items I have so far:
- anya: questionnaire draft (due today 18:00 PT)
- sachin: KMS answers + attestation note (due Tue 10:00 PT)
- dave: pricing + group mapping template (draft by Tue 09:00 PT)
- kevin: confirm pilot RPS and Okta admin (ETA tonight)
- ops-bot/infra: SSO test instance (ETA 24h)

Please update if anything else. we need a clean packet to send to Linda by Tue EOD. :thumbsup:

kevin: updating my CRM notes now. i'll ping here if they confirm numbers early.

anya: will post draft here when ready.

sachin: adding KMS attachments to the questionnaire doc and will link once uploaded.

maria: thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround. if anything blocks you escalate here and @maria.
